# Cloud strips: four thin flat bars across the dawn sky (two over the sun). Facing the camera.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Cloud --base-color 0.8667 0.8314 0.7961 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name C0 --size 1 --location -2.2 0 0.2
scale 3.6 0.05 0.13
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name C1 --size 1 --location -3.4 0 -0.25
scale 2.0 0.05 0.13
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name C2 --size 1 --location 2.4 0 0.15
scale 3.0 0.05 0.13
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name C3 --size 1 --location 3.9 0 -0.2
scale 1.6 0.05 0.13
apply --scale
select C0 C1 C2 C3
active C0
join
rename C0 Clouds
material assign Cloud
shade flat
export cloud.glb
